summary: A survey of the tabloid editors, journalists, assistants, executives, lawyers, prosecutors and private spies who helped Hollywood producer Harvey Weinstein hide his sexual assaults and silence accusers until his 2017 exposure.

evidence.note: host states the story is about the people who enabled Weinstein rather than Weinstein himself
American Media's Pecker and Howard use catch-and-kill and dig up dirt on McGowan
network of friendly journalists and gossip writers planting stories; Benza deal
assistants and female executives used as honeypots in Weinstein Company meetings
2015 NYPD sting with Battilana and the Manhattan DA declining to prosecute
Black Cube ex-Israeli intelligence operatives pose as an investor to spy on McGowan
long segment on Lisa Bloom advising Weinstein in 2016-2017
McGowan's late-1990s Sundance assault and Affleck's reaction, earliest event with real airtime
aftermath through 2018: firing and surrender to the NYPD

notes: Survey of enablers, so the primary subject is a group (as with the Hitler enablers story) and Weinstein is secondary; the lifetime rule therefore does not apply. Roles are a loose fit for a mixed group of journalists, spies, executives and lawyers. His 1970s first assault is a brief mention, so covered span starts at the 1997 McGowan assault. Lisa Bloom birth year from general knowledge.
